commands.name: capture_game_view
commands.description: Render the game view to a PNG. source=camera (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=screen captures the composited backbuffer incl. overlay canvases (Play Mode only). Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in px (default 1280; capped 4096).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in px (default 720; capped 4096).

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Optional camera name (source=camera only); defaults to Camera.main, else the first enabled camera.

parameters.name: save_path
parameters.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

parameters.name: include_inline_image
parameters.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

parameters.name: max_resolution
parameters.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: What to capture: 'camera' (default) renders a camera (misses Screen Space - Overlay UI); 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

commands.name: create_prefab
commands.description: Save a GameObject as a prefab asset at a project path; the source becomes a connected instance.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Reference to the source GameObject to save as a prefab (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Prefab asset path relative to the authoring root (the Assets/ prefix is optional and the .prefab extension is added if missing). e.g. Prefabs/Enemy or Prefabs/Enemy.prefab

schema.title: create_prefab
schema.description: Save a GameObject as a prefab asset at a project path; the source becomes a connected instance.

source.description: Reference to the source GameObject to save as a prefab (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

path.description: Prefab asset path relative to the authoring root (the Assets/ prefix is optional and the .prefab extension is added if missing). e.g. Prefabs/Enemy or Prefabs/Enemy.prefab

commands.name: create_scene
commands.description: Create a new scene and save it to the given path under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Scene path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix and the .unity extension are optional. e.g. Scenes/Level1

parameters.name: additive
parameters.description: Open the new scene additively alongside currently open scenes instead of replacing them.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Initial contents: 'empty' (default) for a blank scene, or 'default' to seed a Main Camera + Directional Light matching Unity's built-in 3D template.

commands.name: save_all
commands.description: Save all open scenes that have unsaved changes.

commands.name: save_prefab_contents
commands.description: Open a prefab asset in an isolated prefab stage, apply a declarative edit, and save it back (nested-prefab safe).

parameters.name: prefab
parameters.description: Reference to the prefab asset to edit (path/guid/globalId).

parameters.name: rename_child
parameters.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root, e.g. 'Body/Head') to rename.

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: New name for the child identified by rename_child.

parameters.name: set_active_child
parameters.description: Optional child name (relative path under the root) whose active state to set.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Active state to apply when set_active_child is provided.

schema.title: save_prefab_contents

active.description: Active state to apply when set_active_child is provided.

commands.name: save_scene
commands.description: Save an open scene. Saves the active scene when no path is given.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the open scene to save (authoring-root relative; Assets/ prefix and .unity optional). Omit to save the active scene.

schema.title: save_scene
